name: @epoch/replay
description: Epoch Replay kernel — deterministic reconstruction (W010): folds event-log streams (single or intersecting) through typed event handlers into a reconstruction with a canonical state digest; divergence detection (replayed digest vs recorded digest mismatch is a typed error); check-pointable folds resumable from a recorded cursor+digest pair. ZERO wall-clock, ZERO randomness — timestamps come from event payload data, never from reading the clock during replay.
